entities.name: João Álvares Fagundes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: João Álvares Fagundes was an explorer and ship owner from Viana do Castelo in Northern Portugal. He organized several expeditions to Newfoundland and Nova Scotia around 1520–1521.
